source.check: Returning Officer's Notice of Result, dated 25 September 1946 (Impartial Reporter, 3 October 1946, p. 3, page image read): the name is entered in column 5 for this division, no poll having been taken

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. No polls were taken: the Returning Officer's notice, dated 25 September 1946, declared the nominated candidates elected (Impartial Reporter, 3 October 1946, p. 3, page image read; also Ulster Herald, 5 October 1946, p. 3). Fifteen divisions are recorded. The notice's Newtownsaville row has no candidate, so no member was returned for it. Returned unopposed.
